messages:
reena: opened PR to update Polaris-Embed model card with explicit shard/replica guidance and a short note about 4-bit quantized variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1689

 dave: can you paste the current limits table here so I can double-check numbers?

 reena: sure:
```
variant | seq_limit | recommended_shards | notes
polaris-embed-v1 | 2048 | 1 per 100qps | standard
polaris-embed-v1-q4 | 2048 | 1 per 80qps | ~15-20% perf drop
```

 marta: nit: change "1 per 100qps" to "1 shard per 100 QPS (approx.)" and add a short line about how to estimate shards for peak vs avg. Customers often overprovision otherwise.

 dave: agree. also add a short SDK snippet for python batch embeddings showing batch_size and max_tokens_per_item hint.

 reena: drafting snippet here:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# batch embeddings, tune batch_size to match memory/latency targets
c.embeddings.create(model='polaris-embed-v1', input=['a','b'], batch_size=16, max_tokens_per_item=128)
```

 docs-bot: preview generated: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/polaris-embed (status: success) :white_check_mark:

 marta: found a broken anchor link to /docs/ops/sharding-estimates, replaced with /docs/guides/sharding-estimates in the PR.

 dave: LGTM. small wording tweak about q4 variants: "Quantized (q4) variants typically show ~15-25% lower throughput on A10G at high batch sizes; test with representative prompts." include link to bench run: https://bench.redwood/runs/1689-polaris

 reena: added bench line and changed shard phrasing. ready to merge after one more review.

 marta: approved.

 reena: merged. changelog entry: "Polaris-Embed: clarified shard estimation, added SDK batch snippet, noted q4 perf delta and bench link."
